title: Sardarapat, May 1918: the battle that made the First Republic possible #Armenia
description:
Fought from May 21 to 29, 1918, near Yerevan, the Battle of Sardarapat halted the Ottoman invasion and enabled the declaration of the First Republic of Armenia.
